text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

title.zh-TW: 註冊完成即得 $100 折扣金

text.zh-TW: 好友購物完成後，推薦人也可獲得 $100 折扣金。 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Once your friend completes a purchase, the referrer also gets a $100 voucher. From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會用外部瀏覽器開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it opens in your external browser).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示註冊寵i會員；若要求邀請碼，請輸入 Kz3bJHJMi4。
steps.en: Register as a Watsons member as the page asks; if it asks for an invite code, enter Kz3bJHJMi4.

steps.zh-TW: 完成註冊後，依活動規則取得折扣金。
steps.en: After registering, receive the voucher under the campaign rules.

intro.zh-TW: 透過推薦連結加入屈臣氏寵i會員：新會員最高回饋 $250，註冊完成即得 $100 折扣金。
intro.en: Join Watsons through the referral link: new members get up to $250 in rewards, plus a $100 discount voucher on registering.

description.zh-TW:
屈臣氏（Watsons）是以保養、美妝與健康商品為主的零售品牌，寵i會員是它的會員計畫。透過本站連結註冊時，邀請碼 Kz3bJHJMi4 已包含在連結中；若頁面另外要求邀請碼，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。

本頁提到的新會員回饋與折扣金，皆取自平台分享文案，實際內容、金額與期限以屈臣氏官方公告為準。
description.en:
Watsons is a retail brand focused on personal care, beauty and health products, and this referral is for its membership program. The invite code Kz3bJHJMi4 is already part of the referral link; if the sign-up page asks for a code, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

The rewards mentioned on this page for new members come from the platform's share text, so actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow Watsons' official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 邀請碼 Kz3bJHJMi4 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫）。
notes.en: Invite code Kz3bJHJMi4 is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.
